verses.text_en: And after that I saw all the secrets of the heavens, and how the kingdom is divided, and how the actions of men are weighed in the balance.
verses.text_hr: Nakon toga vidio sam sve tajne nebesa: kako je kraljevstvo razdijeljeno i kako se djela ljudi važu na tezulji.

verses.text_en: And there I saw the mansions of the elect and the mansions of the holy, and mine eyes saw there all the sinners being driven from thence which deny the name of the Lord of Spirits, and being dragged off: and they could not abide because of the punishment which proceeds from the Lord of Spirits.
verses.text_hr: Ondje sam vidio boravišta izabranih i boravišta svetih. Moje su oči vidjele kako odande izgone i odvlače sve grešnike koji niječu ime Gospodara duhova. Nisu mogli ostati zbog kazne koja dolazi od Gospodara duhova.

verses.text_en: And there mine eyes saw the secrets of the lightning and of the thunder, and the secrets of the winds, how they are divided to blow over the earth, and the secrets of the clouds and dew, and there I saw from whence they proceed in that place and from whence they saturate the dusty earth.
verses.text_hr: Ondje su moje oči vidjele tajne munje i groma, tajne vjetrova i kako se razdjeljuju da bi puhali nad zemljom, zatim tajne oblaka i rose. Vidio sam odakle na tome mjestu izlaze i odakle natapaju prašnjavu zemlju.

verses.text_en: And there I saw closed chambers out of which the winds are divided, the chamber of the hail and winds, the chamber of the mist, and of the clouds, and the cloud thereof hovers over the earth from the beginning of the world.
verses.text_hr: Ondje sam vidio zatvorene odaje iz kojih se razdjeljuju vjetrovi: odaju tuče i vjetrova, odaju magle i oblaka; njihov oblak lebdi nad zemljom od početka svijeta.

verses.text_en: And I saw the chambers of the sun and moon, whence they proceed and whither they come again, and their glorious return, and how one is superior to the other, and their stately orbit, and how they do not leave their orbit, and they add nothing to their orbit and they take nothing from it, and they keep faith with each other, in accordance with the oath by which they are bound together.
verses.text_hr: Vidio sam odaje sunca i mjeseca, odakle izlaze i kamo se vraćaju, njihov slavni povratak, kako je jedno uzvišenije od drugoga, njihove veličanstvene putanje i kako ih ne napuštaju. Ništa ne dodaju svojoj putanji niti od nje išta oduzimaju, nego ostaju vjerni jedno drugomu prema zakletvi koja ih veže.

verses.text_en: And first the sun goes forth and traverses his path according to the commandment of the Lord of Spirits, and mighty is His name for ever and ever.
verses.text_hr: Najprije izlazi sunce i prolazi svojim putem prema zapovijedi Gospodara duhova, čije je ime moćno u vijeke vjekova.

Nakon toga vidio sam skriveni i vidljivi put mjeseca. On na tome mjestu dovršava tijek svojega puta danju i noću; jedno stoji nasuprot drugomu pred Gospodarom duhova.

Zahvaljuju i hvale bez prestanka,
jer im je zahvaljivanje odmor.

verses.text_en:
For the sun changes oft for a blessing or a curse,
And the course of the path of the moon is light to the righteous,
And darkness to the sinners in the name of the Lord,
Who made a separation between the light and the darkness,
And divided the spirits of men,
And strengthened the spirits of the righteous,
In the name of His righteousness.
verses.text_hr:
Sunce se često mijenja na blagoslov ili na prokletstvo,
a tijek mjesečeva puta jest svjetlost pravednima
i tama grešnicima, u ime Gospodina
koji je razdvojio svjetlost od tame,
razlučio ljudske duhove
i ojačao duhove pravednih
u ime svoje pravednosti.

verses.text_en: For no angel hinders and no power is able to hinder; for He appoints a judge for them all and he judges them all before Him.
verses.text_hr: Nijedan anđeo ne priječi i nijedna sila ne može spriječiti, jer on svima postavlja suca, a taj im svima sudi pred njim.
